question: Five boxes numbered 36, 74, 27, 51 and 92 are kept one above the other, not necessarily in the same order. Box 51 is on the topmost position. Only box 92 is between box 74 and box 36. Only one box is above box 27. Box 36 is not at the bottom most position. Which box is kept in the exact middle position?
solution:
Five boxes numbered 36, 74, 27, 51 and 92 are kept one above the other.

1) Box 51 is on the topmost position

2) Only one box is above box 27

 
 

 **Boxes**
 
 

 51
 
 

 27
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

3) Only box 92 is between box 74 and box 36

4) Box 36 is not at the bottom most position

 

 
 

 Boxes
 
 

 51
 
 

 27
 
 

 36 
 
 

 92
 
 

 74
 
 

 

**Box 36 is kept in the exact middle position.**

Hence, the **correct answer** is **"Option 3"**
